_meta.description: Accelerator energy profiles. peak_flops_bf16 is dense (non-sparse) vendor-published throughput.
_meta.phase_note: Prefill (prompt processing) is compute-bound and reaches high FLOP utilization. Decode (token generation) is memory-bandwidth-bound, so achieved FLOP utilization collapses even though the chip still draws near-TDP power. Modeling the two phases separately is what keeps the energy estimate honest.
_meta.utilization_source: Published MFU ranges for served transformer inference on dense BF16 kernels.
